subject: Request: remedy tiering & pricing waiver for Sentinel AI pilot
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.inference>
Cc: 
Date: Sat, 10 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: remedy tiering & pricing waiver for Sentinel AI pilot

Hi team,

Summary: Sentinel (pilot, acq pipeline) experienced a burst of latency incidents during initial multi-region ingest. They’ve signaled they need a tighter ramp plan and are asking for both a more forgiving remedy schedule (tiered credits instead of a single heavy credit) and a one-time commercial concession to keep the pilot on track. We’ve attached the incident summary and our proposed options.

Why this matters: Sentinel is on a fast timeline to convert to Dedicated next quarter and they will be a reference for our observability work in financial services vertical. If we lose momentum because procurement drags on or they insist on a large, immediate service credit, we risk the deal and a high-leverage reference.

Proposal (options attached in redwood_remedy_options.xlsx):
- Option A (preferred): Tiered remedy schedule: smaller partial credits during pilot months 1–2, capped aggregate credit of $40k. No change to uptime target; remedies apply only to pilot environment until GA.
- Option B: One-time 15% invoice credit + engineering SLA review and a 30-day grace window for production ramp.
- Option C: Full standard SLO credit as requested (not recommended without exec signoff).

Ask: I need an executive signoff for Option A or B so we can finalize terms with Sentinel procurement and get DocuSign out this week. If we choose A, Legal needs authority to accept the cap and Finance needs approval for the credit reserve.

Attachments: sentinel_slo_incident_summary.pdf, redwood_remedy_options.xlsx

Next steps I propose:
- Jonas: recommend commercial delta and signoff path (deal desk).
- Ben: confirm any pricing/discount impact on ARR and renewal numbers for forecasting.
- Aditya: confirm engineering mitigation commitments and timeline.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sr. Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.inference>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.inference>, Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2027 10:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: remedy tiering & pricing waiver for Sentinel AI pilot

Marissa — thanks for the clear options. My read: Option A preserves our long-term economics while addressing customer risk; Option B accelerates revenue impact but buys faster procurement progress.

Quick commercial notes:
- Option A -> projected revenue impact = $40k (one-time reserve) and no ongoing price change; keeps product commitments intact.
- Option B -> approx 15% credit on next invoice, unknown knock-on effect for renewal negotiations (customer may expect similar concessions later).

Recommend: Ask Sean for final exec approval on Option A with strict conditions: (1) cap at $40k, (2) remedy applies only to pilot nodes (no production SLA change), (3) DocuSign amendment + PO on file before issuance.

Jonas
Jonas Weber
Head of Deal Desk

On Tue, Jul 13, 2027 at 09:12 AM Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference> wrote:
> (original message attached)
From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.inference>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 16 Jul 2027 14:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: remedy tiering & pricing waiver for Sentinel AI pilot

Appreciate the write-up. I’m OK to approve a constrained commercial concession to keep the pilot live, subject to conditions below. Approving Option A with modifications:

Approved concession (conditions):
- One-time aggregate credit cap: $40,000 (cap absolute).
- Remedy tiering applies to pilot environment for months 1–2 only; production SLA unchanged.
- No adjustment to standard uptime target in the master SLA — only credit mechanics are altered for pilot nodes.
- Legal must attach a short amendment (signed) that: (a) limits remedy to listed pilot hostnames/IDs; (b) states credits do not set precedent for renewal pricing; (c) requires customer PO and countersigned amendment before any credit is applied.
- Finance: place a $40k reserve against DEAL-2027-1229 until amendment countersigned.
- Engineering: deliver mitigation plan and ETA for fix to reduce recurrence risk; weekly status updates for 6 weeks.

Ben — please confirm financial treatment & whether we need additional exec approval for >$25k credits; Aditya — confirm engineering timeline by EOD Monday. Marissa, I want a short one-page memo for the Exec Comms channel summarizing this concession for transparency.

Sean Gallagher
VP, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Alicia Gomez <agomez@sentinel.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.inference>
Cc: Marcus Reed <mreed@sentinel.ai>, contracts@sentinel.ai, Jin Park <jin.park@procure.sentinel.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 17:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: remedy tiering & pricing waiver for Sentinel AI pilot

Marissa/Team — thank you, and appreciate Sean’s clarity. Sentinel accepts the modified Option A (aggregate cap $40k and pilot-only remedy tiering) subject to the following:

- We require the amendment to explicitly list the pilot hostnames and the effective pilot period (Jul 1–Sep 30, 2027).
- DocuSign ready by COB Thursday (we attached PO 8742).
- We’d like a short operational runbook for incident escalation (to avoid confusion on when credits are triggered).

Attachments: sentinel_po_8742.pdf

We’ll route the amendment to our legal immediately once we receive it. If DocuSign is ready this week we can start the pilot ramp next Monday.

Thanks — Alicia
Alicia Gomez
Head of Cloud Operations, Sentinel AI
